as_told.title: Napkin is ironclad proof the story reached Obama

plain: A napkin from Camp David, printed with the presidential seal, was photographed and the picture mailed to Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says UFOs appear around him, by a man named Timothy Taylor. That is the account of Bob McGwier (also given as Bob Maguire), a CIA contractor who says he knew both the address and the napkin, and who says the only person the story in that envelope could have been told to was Barack Obama. To him "the letter to me is ironclad proof that Chris's story was taken all the way to Barack Obama via Tim Taylor"; in one telling he says he saw the napkin and envelope in a Facebook photo posted by the UFO researcher Grant Cameron. Bledsoe himself tells Michels more bluntly: "He briefed Obama on me. That's where this come from." If so, Bledsoe's experiences would have reached the president.
